name: Module 1b: cell prep
source: PLACEHOLDER, after the sheet's cell-prep rows (contracts/sources/chip_geometry_requirements.xlsx): quench, wash, 30 um filter (10x / inDrops / TIP-seq), viability >= 90% (10x), resuspend in 15% dextran (SPC-NAR) at ~0.1 cells per capsule (SPC-NAR / CapSeq). Volumes, flows and times are placeholders; the cell-wash method is TBC.
description: Merge the three Module 1 lanes, quench, wash, filter, count, resuspend at the concentration Module 2 needs (the operator sets the dilution from the count), and send the cells to Module 2's core inlet once the safety checker approves.

steps.note: Cells from m1_out_1/2/3 arrive at m1b_cells_in_1/2/3 and merge. They were labelled per chamber in Module 1, so they can share one line.
Quench: medium joins the cells at the T-junction and the serpentine mixes it in, neutralising the detach reagent.
Wash the cells into clean buffer; the old liquid goes to waste. (Method TBC: DLD array, spiral channel or density cushion.)
Through the 30 um pillar filter to the QC window: clumps stay behind, single cells go on.
Count: the QC window reads the cell concentration and viability.
Resuspend in dextran buffer at the dilution that gives about 0.1 cells per capsule in Module 2; the operator sets it from the count.
Cells out to Module 2's core inlet, once the safety checker approves them.
